decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly casting low-cost creatures and burn spells to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. By utilizing aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Bushwhacker, along with powerful burn spells like Chain Lightning and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to establish their own game plan. The inclusion of cards like Mutagenic Growth and Lava Dart provide additional reach and flexibility in combat situations, allowing the deck to maintain pressure and secure victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and defensive creatures. Utilizing the Gates lands to fix mana and provide additional utility, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through card advantage and efficient use of resources. The inclusion of Prismatic Strands provides protection against aggressive strategies, while Squadron Hawk offers card advantage and Guardian of the Guildpact serves as a resilient threat. With a mix of control elements and a solid mana base, this deck aims to grind out victories through attrition and careful decision-making.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using cheap and efficient red spells and creatures. By utilizing cards like Chain Lightning, Lightning Bolt, and Goblin Bushwhacker, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early on and finish them off before they can stabilize. Cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Mutagenic Growth help to pump up the creatures and increase the damage output. With a low curve and a high velocity of spells, this Aggro - Red Deck Wins aims for a swift victory in the Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to rapidly deploy low-cost creatures and disrupt the opponent's plans with counterspells and removal spells. By combining card draw with evasion abilities and efficient spells, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure and maintain control of the board. With a versatile mix of creatures and spells, this deck looks to outpace the opponent and make optimal use of its resources to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly putting artifact creatures onto the battlefield and boosting them with equipment spells to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. Utilizing cards like Myr Enforcer, Frogmite, and Ornithopter alongside mana acceleration cards like Springleaf Drum, the deck aims to swarm the board early on and maintain pressure throughout the game. With the ability to draw cards efficiently through Thoughtcast and Reverse Engineer, the deck aims to consistently refill its hand and keep up the pressure on the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering spells and removal, while digging for key cards with card draw and selection effects. Gurmag Angler serves as a powerful finisher, backed up by removal spells like Snuff Out and Cast Down. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thought Scour and Tolarian Terror, while utilizing lands like Ice Tunnel and Contaminated Aquifer to fix mana and gain additional advantages. Overall, the deck is designed to outmaneuver and overwhelm opponents through careful resource management and strategic play.

The main focus of this Pauper Mono Blue Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with low-cost creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck also utilizes card draw and graveyard interaction to maintain tempo and fuel the big threats. Overall, the strategy revolves around applying pressure early in the game and maintaining control through counterspells and efficient creatures.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on playing efficient, low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Kor Skyfisher, supported by removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Journey to Nowhere to clear the opponent's board. The deck also includes artifacts like Relic of Progenitus and Experimental Synthesizer for additional card advantage and utility. The lands are mostly dual-colored to ensure mana consistency, and the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive creatures and removal spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using low-cost burn spells and aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck aims to burn through the opponent's life total as quickly as possible. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Chain Lightning and Fireblast provides additional reach to finish off the opponent. The deck is designed to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize or mount a defense.

The main idea of this deck is to aggressively play low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with damage. By utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt, Galvanic Blast, and Chain Lightning, along with creature buffs like Goblin Bushwhacker and Kuldotha Rebirth, the deck aims to consistently deal damage to the opponent's life total. With a focus on speed and efficiency, this Aggro Red Deck Wins archetype looks to quickly close out games before the opponent can mount a defense.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements such as Counterspell and Prismatic Strands to stall opponents while using Gates synergies to generate mana and gain card advantage. The inclusion of Guardian of the Guildpact provides a solid defensive creature, while Squadron Hawk offers card advantage and flying threats. Journey to Nowhere handles troublesome creatures, and various Gates cards help fix mana and provide additional utility. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue opponents through a combination of control elements and gate synergies.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells to deal damage as quickly as possible. By utilizing cards like Goblin Bushwhacker, Monastery Swiftspear, and Goblin Blast-Runner, along with efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, the deck aims to maintain a fast pace and put pressure on the opponent from the start. The inclusion of cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Implement of Combustion provides additional damage output and synergy with the overall aggressive strategy.

This control deck focuses on recurring value through the use of Ephemerate to blink creatures like Archaeomancer and Mulldrifter, while also controlling the board with Counterspell and removal spells like Skred and Cleansing Wildfire. The deck also utilizes card draw and filtering with Preordain and Brainstorm to help find key pieces. The mana base is built using mostly snow-covered lands to support spells like Skred and Late to Dinner. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent through card advantage and efficient removal while maintaining control of the game.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, efficient creatures while utilizing protective spells like Prismatic Strands and removal like Journey to Nowhere. The deck includes cards that generate tokens and provide card advantage, along with pump spells like Guardians' Pledge to enhance the power of the creatures. The goal is to maintain a strong board presence and pressure the opponent into making unfavorable trades, ultimately leading to victory through sheer numbers and aggression.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and efficient creatures, while also utilizing gate lands to ensure consistent and smooth mana base. The deck aims to stabilize the board early on with creatures like Squadron Hawk and Guardian of the Guildpact, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with Counterspell and Journey to Nowhere. Prismatic Strands provides protection when needed, and the inclusion of card draw and scry effects like Preordain and Brainstorm helps maintain card advantage and selection.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly swarm the battlefield with cheap artifact creatures and use affinity mechanics to reduce their casting costs. By combining artifacts with cards like Thoughtcast and Reverse Engineer, the deck aims to draw cards quickly and maintain card advantage. Additionally, cards like All That Glitters and Kenku Artificer provide buffs to the creatures, making them even more threatening on the battlefield. The inclusion of artifact lands and artifact spells like Springleaf Drum further enhances the deck's ability to generate mana and play out its threats efficiently.
